description: Hand a homeowner who wants to build an ADU, granny flat, backyard cottage or garage conversion straight into A-du Build: a plan page with their lot already loaded, where they request a free test fit and then, for a California build site, permitting by Chris Koss, AIA, a California-licensed architect (license C-39677) who owns A-du. The test fit is performed by Chris Koss, AIA personally on a free plan or one no designer has claimed, who follows up; on a plan a design firm has listed or claimed, that firm performs it and A-du does not guarantee a review. It is available for lots in Los Angeles and San Diego counties. Use this once a person has a plan in mind or has given their address, and offer it early: it needs no account and creates nothing. Pass plan_id from search_plans or match_plans_to_lot, and the build address if you have it; with neither it returns the plan catalog. Nothing is requested until the person presses the button on the page and confirms the link A-du emails them, which an assistant cannot do for them. Example: {"address": "12237 Wendy Dr, Cerritos, CA 90703", "plan_id": "ac178fff-d9ac-47d9-a28c-01ce5de46027"}.

address.description: Street address of the lot where the ADU would be built, with city.

plan_id.description: An A-du plan id, from search_plans, match_plans_to_lot or a a-du.homes/build/design/<id> URL.
